assets/jungle-book/story-sounds/en/porri.text: Little Rabbit and Mother Rabbit have no food. Little Rabbit goes into the woods.
In the woods, a kind badger gives Little Rabbit a little magic pot.
“Cook, little pot, cook!” makes porridge. “Stop, little pot!” makes it stop.
Little Rabbit takes the pot home and shows Mother the words. Now they have sweet porridge to eat.
One day, Little Rabbit goes out to play. Mother Rabbit stays at home.
Mother says, “Cook, little pot, cook!” But she forgets the words to stop it.
The pot keeps cooking. Porridge spills over the table and fills the kitchen.
The porridge flows out of the door and down the lane. Little Rabbit sees it and hurries home.
“Stop, little pot!” calls Little Rabbit. At once, the pot stops cooking.
Everyone brings a bowl and helps eat the porridge. Soon the lane is clear, and no one is hungry.
